query:
SELECT id, title FROM books
     WHERE left(kdc, 1) = (SELECT left(kdc, 1) FROM books WHERE id = $1) AND id <> $1
     ORDER BY popularity DESC LIMIT 6
SELECT id, rating, body, created_at FROM reviews WHERE book_id = $1 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT $2
SELECT AVG(rating) AS avg, COUNT(*) AS count FROM reviews WHERE book_id = $1

SELECT b.*, COALESCE(array_agg(a.name ORDER BY ba.position) FILTER (WHERE a.name IS NOT NULL), $2) AS authors
     FROM books b
     LEFT JOIN book_authors ba ON ba.book_id = b.id
     LEFT JOIN authors a ON a.id = ba.author_id
     WHERE b.id = $1
     GROUP BY b.id
